bands.bio: Formed in Sacramento in 1988, Deftones fused the aggression of metal with dreamy, shoegaze-influenced atmospherics, becoming one of the most sonically distinct bands in the alternative metal scene.
bands.history: Formed in Sacramento in 1988, Deftones revolutionized alternative metal by fusing heavy riffs with dreamy, shoegaze-influenced atmospherics. Over three decades, they've evolved from a regional nu-metal act into one of the most respected and influential bands in heavy music, known for their meticulous production and emotional depth.
achievements: Platinum certifications for White Pony and Diamond Eyes
Influenced countless metal and alternative bands

vinyls.description: Deftones' third album and their breakthrough, swapping straight nu-metal aggression for atmosphere, trip-hop textures and Chino Moreno's dreamier vocals. Tool's Maynard James Keenan guests on "Passenger", and "Elite" won the band a Grammy.
vinyls.label: Maverick

vinyls.description: The second Deftones record, produced by Terry Date, where their trademark swing between crushing riffs and quiet tension first clicked. Home to "My Own Summer (Shove It)" and "Be Quiet and Drive (Far Away)", with Max Cavalera guesting on "Headup".
vinyls.label: Maverick

vinyls.description: Made after bassist Chi Cheng's car accident, with Sergio Vega stepping in on bass, Diamond Eyes is a punchy, defiant comeback. At just over 41 minutes it is Deftones' shortest album.
vinyls.label: Reprise

bands.bio: Formed in Glendale, California in 1994, System of a Down blended thrash riffs, Armenian folk influences, and politically charged, often satirical lyrics into a wholly unique sound.
bands.history: Formed in Glendale, California in 1994, System of a Down blended thrash metal riffs, Armenian folk influences, and politically charged, often satirical lyrics into a wholly unique sound. The band became one of the most commercially successful and critically acclaimed metal bands of the 2000s, known for their activism and social commentary.
achievements: One of the most-streamed metal bands globally

vinyls.description: System of a Down's second album, produced with Rick Rubin, topped the Billboard 200 and made the band a global name. Armenian folk melodies, thrash bursts and political lyrics collide on "Chop Suey!", "Aerials" and the title track.
vinyls.label: American / Columbia

vinyls.description: The raw, fast and gleefully strange debut, produced by Rick Rubin. Singles "Sugar" and "Spiders" set up everything that followed, and the album later went platinum on the back of Toxicity's success.
vinyls.label: American / Columbia

vinyls.description: The first half of the Mezmerize/Hypnotize double album, and at about 36 minutes the band's shortest studio record. "B.Y.O.B." won the Grammy for Best Hard Rock Performance.
vinyls.label: American / Columbia

tracks.name: This Cocaine Makes Me Feel Like I'm on This Song

bands.bio: Formed in Los Angeles in 1990, Tool is known for their intricate, odd-metered compositions, philosophical lyrical themes, and a famously meticulous approach to visual and sonic art.
bands.history: Formed in Los Angeles in 1990, Tool is known for their intricate, odd-metered compositions, philosophical lyrical themes, and a famously meticulous approach to visual and sonic art. The band's perfectionism has resulted in some of the most critically acclaimed albums in metal history, with each release representing years of careful craftsmanship.
achievements: Won Grammy Award for Best Metal Performance

vinyls.description: Tool's third album: long, interlocking progressive pieces built on odd time signatures, with the title track's vocal phrasing following the Fibonacci sequence. "Schism" won the Grammy for Best Metal Performance.
vinyls.label: Volcano

vinyls.description: Tool's fourth album opens with "Vicarious" and centres on the two-part "Wings for Marie" / "10,000 Days", Maynard James Keenan's tribute to his mother. It debuted at number one on the Billboard 200.
vinyls.label: Tool Dissectional / Volcano

vinyls.description: Tool's second album and the first with bassist Justin Chancellor: darker and heavier than Undertow, broken up by strange, sardonic interludes. The track "Ænema" won the Grammy for Best Metal Performance.
vinyls.label: Zoo / Volcano

bands.bio: Formed in Des Moines, Iowa in 1995, Slipknot is known for their nine-member lineup, masked stage personas, and brutally heavy, chaotic sound that redefined extreme metal for a new generation.
bands.history: Formed in Des Moines, Iowa in 1995, Slipknot redefined extreme metal with their nine-member lineup, masked stage personas, and brutally heavy, chaotic sound. The band became the gateway to heavy music for millions, known for their intense live performances and evolving production style that balances brutality with melody.
achievements: Evolved from shock metal to sophisticated composition
Influenced a generation of metal bands

vinyls.description: Slipknot's second album is widely seen as the heaviest and bleakest record in their catalog, made while the band was close to falling apart. It closes with the 15-minute title track.
vinyls.label: Roadrunner

vinyls.description: The self-titled debut that introduced the masked nine-piece from Des Moines, produced by Ross Robinson. "Wait and Bleed" earned the band its first Grammy nomination.
vinyls.label: Roadrunner

vinyls.description: Produced by Rick Rubin, Vol. 3 is Slipknot's most melodic and experimental record, from the ballad "Vermilion Pt. 2" to "Duality". "Before I Forget" won the Grammy for Best Metal Performance.
vinyls.label: Roadrunner

bands.bio: Formed in Los Angeles in 1991, Rage Against the Machine fused hip-hop cadences with thrash-heavy riffs and unapologetically radical politics, becoming one of the most influential and confrontational bands of the 90s.
bands.history: Formed in Los Angeles in 1991, Rage Against the Machine fused hip-hop cadences with thrash-heavy riffs and unapologetically radical politics. Though active for only 8 years before initially disbanding, their cultural impact was massive, serving as a template for politically engaged heavy music and protest art.
achievements: Broke barriers between rap and metal genres
Political activism became part of their brand
Reunited multiple times for benefit concerts

vinyls.description: The debut that fused hip-hop vocals, funk-metal grooves and radical politics into something new. "Killing in the Name" became one of the defining protest anthems of the 1990s.
vinyls.label: Epic

vinyls.description: Rage's second album debuted at number one on the Billboard 200, with Tom Morello's guitar sounding more like a turntable than ever on "Bulls on Parade". "Tire Me" won the Grammy for Best Metal Performance.
vinyls.label: Epic

vinyls.description: The band's last album of original material also debuted at number one, tighter and leaner than its predecessors. "Guerrilla Radio" won the Grammy for Best Hard Rock Performance.
vinyls.label: Epic

bands.bio: Formed in Bakersfield, California in 1993, Korn pioneered the nu metal sound with detuned seven-string riffs, raw emotional lyrics, and a bass-and-groove-driven heaviness that reshaped heavy music in the late 90s.
bands.history: Formed in Bakersfield, California in 1993, Korn pioneered the nu metal sound with detuned seven-string riffs, raw emotional lyrics, and a bass-and-groove-driven heaviness that reshaped heavy music in the late 90s. Jonathan Davis's emotional vulnerability combined with Fieldy's innovative bass work created a sonic blueprint that countless bands would follow.
achievements: Pioneers of the nu metal movement
Influenced the sound of extreme metal
Jonathan Davis became an icon of 90s metal

vinyls.description: The 1994 debut, produced by Ross Robinson, is widely credited with starting nu metal: down-tuned seven-string riffs, slap bass and Jonathan Davis's painfully personal lyrics. It opens with "Blind".
vinyls.label: Immortal / Epic

vinyls.description: Korn's commercial breakthrough debuted at number one on the Billboard 200, and the "Freak on a Leash" video won a Grammy. Guests include Ice Cube and Fred Durst.
vinyls.label: Immortal / Epic

vinyls.description: Korn's fourth album also debuted at number one, mixing short interludes with singles "Falling Away from Me", "Make Me Bad" and "Somebody Someone". Its cover was picked from a fan art contest.
vinyls.label: Immortal / Epic
